first.rationale: I currently intend to test onboarding simplification because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence suggests this can improve time-to-value and first-week activation. I would use a guarded test because the archived results need verification and the direct effect on sustainable qualified revenue is uncertain.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding, with segment-level measurement of completion, activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue. This directly addresses both current declines and is supported by verified evidence: onboarding shortening improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased retention; signup simplification improved SMB activation and qualified revenue but slightly reduced retention and has not been validated beyond SMB. Guard against downstream value loss by monitoring retention and revenue, especially if signup changes are included.
